content:
name: EOS event recovery

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target:
        description: "Existing EOS lifecycle target missing a root event"
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: eos-event-recovery-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  recover:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      EOS_ACTOR: eos-integrity-recovery
      TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Validate recovery target
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          if [[ -z "$TARGET" ]]; then
            echo "Recovery target is empty" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Import missing root lifecycle event
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import importlib.util
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          root = Path.cwd()
          spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("monad_eos", root / "tools/eos/eos.py")
          eos = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
          assert spec.loader is not None
          spec.loader.exec_module(eos)

          target = os.environ["TARGET"]
          kind = eos.kind_for_id(target)
          row = eos.find_row(kind, target)
          if row is None:
              raise SystemExit(f"{target} is not present in the canonical {kind} registry")

          roots = [
              event for event in eos.read_events()
              if event.get("target") == target
              and event.get("event_type") in {"ENTITY_CREATED", "ENTITY_IMPORTED"}
          ]
          if roots:
              raise SystemExit(f"{target} already has {len(roots)} root lifecycle event(s); refusing recovery")

          eos.append_event(
              "ENTITY_IMPORTED",
              target=target,
              entity_kind=kind,
              action="recovery-import",
              to_state=row.get("status", ""),
              actor="eos-integrity-recovery",
              reason="recover missing root lifecycle event for an existing canonical registry object",
              metadata={"row": row, "recovery": "missing-root-event"},
          )
          print(f"Recovered {target} at state {row.get('status', '')}")
          PY

      - name: Regenerate trace before machine projection
        run: python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write

      - name: Regenerate machine documents from settled trace
        run: python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Verify recovered canonical state
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Commit recovered event and projections
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git add .eos/events.jsonl .eos/trace-edges.tsv machine
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            echo "Unexpected unstaged changes outside recovered event/projection paths:" >&2
            git status --short >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git commit -m "chore(eos): recover missing lifecycle root event"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
